entries.title: Theorem A：径向逃逸
entries.source_excerpt:
\begin{theoremA}[Radial escape]
If $z_0\in\C\setminus\{0\}$ and $J_0(z_0)=1$, then
\[
   |J_0(cz_0)|>c^{7/25}\qquad(c>1).
\]
The exponent $7/25$ is a convenient uniform margin and is not asserted to
be optimal.
\end{theoremA}
entries.mathematical_meaning: 对每个非零1点z0及每个实c>1，|J0(cz0)|>c^(7/25)。7/25仅为统一有效指数，并无最优性断言。
entries.bridges: RadialEscape展开恰为非零J0一点评价、所有实c>1及Real.rpow(c,7/25)<norm J0(cz)。没有最优性命题需要额外root。

entries.title: Corollary B：每射线至多一个非零1点
entries.source_excerpt:
\begin{corollaryB}[Solution of Problem~2.45]
For every $\theta\in[0,2\pi)$,
\[
   \#\{r>0:J_0(re^{i\theta})=1\}\le1.
\]
Equivalently, no two distinct nonzero $1$-points of $J_0$ lie on the same
open ray from the origin.
\end{corollaryB}
entries.mathematical_meaning: 对每个θ∈[0,2π)，集合{r>0:J0(r exp(iθ))=1}的基数至多1；等价于任意两个不同非零1点不在同一开射线上。

entries.title: 二维公共谱方程及正比缩放改写
entries.source_excerpt:
\cite[Part~III, \S\S3--4]{Delsarte1961}.  In dimension two the common
spectral equations are
\[
   J_0(i\lambda r_1)=J_0(i\lambda r_2)=1,\qquad\lambda\ne0.
\]
If $0<r_1<r_2$, $c=r_2/r_1$, and $z=i\lambda r_1$, these equations become
$J_0(z)=J_0(cz)=1$.  Thus a positive nonunit spectral ratio occurs exactly
when two nonzero $1$-points lie on one open ray.
entries.mathematical_meaning: 二维非零公共固定谱满足J0(iλr1)=J0(iλr2)=1且λ≠0。若0<r1<r2，令c=r2/r1、z=iλr1，则改写为J0(z)=J0(cz)=1；非零公共谱对应同一开射线上的两个非零1点。
assumptions_and_quantifiers: λ∈C\{0}；该非零限定已在引言L111显式给出，与Proposition 6.1 L644一致。
entries.bridges: spectral_equivalence保留λ≠0及正半径。共同频率产生α=iλr1、β=iλr2，并给根比r1/r2；对0<r1<r2取c=r2/r1，conditional.Spectral中hscale以v=iλ、a=r1、b=r2实例化给cα=β。hEscape由paper_5_2提供，不留下通用解析前提。

entries.title: Corollary C：局部及全空间两半径结论
entries.source_excerpt:
\begin{corollaryC}[Removal of the planar spectral obstruction]
Let $B_R:=\{x\in\R^2:|x|<R\}$, let $r_1,r_2$ be distinct positive radii,
and let $R>r_1+r_2$.  If $f\in L^1_{\mathrm{loc}}(B_R)$ satisfies the
normalized circular mean identities at $r_1$ and $r_2$ almost everywhere
on their natural domains, then $\Delta f=0$ in $\D'(B_R)$.  In the
full-space case, if $f\in L^1_{\mathrm{loc}}(\R^2)$ satisfies the two
identities almost everywhere on $\R^2$, then $\Delta f=0$ in $\D'(\R^2)$.
\end{corollaryC}
entries.mathematical_meaning: 若不同正半径r1,r2的规范圆周平均固定f，局部在R>r1+r2时Δf=0于D′(B_R)；全空间时Δf=0于D′(R²)。
assumptions_and_quantifiers: 全空间f∈L1_loc(R²)，两式几乎处处于R²。
entries.bridges: 分别取局部结论与全空间结论的第一合取；其余Weyl和连续性结论增强涵盖引言。L1loc前提用于真实分布桥，Δf=0非全定义默认零。

theorem F_sub_one (w : ℂ) : F w - 1 = w * Q w := by
  have hs := (fTerm_summable w).sum_add_tsum_nat_add 1
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_one, fTerm, pow_zero, Nat.factorial_zero,
    Nat.cast_one, one_pow, div_one] at hs
  have ht : (∑' n : ℕ, w ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℂ) ^ 2) =
      w * Q w := by
    rw [Q, ← tsum_mul_left]
    apply tsum_congr
    intro n
    simp only [pow_succ]
    ring
  change (1 : ℂ) + (∑' n : ℕ, w ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℂ) ^ 2) = F w at hs
  rw [ht] at hs
  linear_combination -hs

theorem F_ode (w : ℂ) : w * deriv (deriv F) w + deriv F w = F w := by
  have hfirst := F_firstDerivative_hasSum w
  have hsecond := F_secondDerivative_hasSum w
  have hfirstSplit := hfirst.summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add 1
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_one, pow_zero, mul_one,
    FFirstCoefficient_zero] at hfirstSplit
  rw [hfirst.tsum_eq] at hfirstSplit
  have htailEq :
      (∑' n : ℕ, FFirstCoefficient (n + 1) * w ^ (n + 1)) = deriv F w - 1 := by
    linear_combination hfirstSplit
  have htailSummable :
      Summable (fun n : ℕ => FFirstCoefficient (n + 1) * w ^ (n + 1)) :=
    (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr hfirst.summable
  have htail : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => FFirstCoefficient (n + 1) * w ^ (n + 1))
      (deriv F w - 1) := by
    rw [← htailEq]
    exact htailSummable.hasSum
  have hcombined := (hsecond.mul_left w).add htail
  have hfun :
      (fun n : ℕ => w * (FSecondCoefficient n * w ^ n) +
        FFirstCoefficient (n + 1) * w ^ (n + 1)) =
      (fun n : ℕ => fTerm w (n + 1)) := by
    funext n
    calc
      w * (FSecondCoefficient n * w ^ n) +
          FFirstCoefficient (n + 1) * w ^ (n + 1) =
          (FSecondCoefficient n + FFirstCoefficient (n + 1)) * w ^ (n + 1) := by
        rw [pow_succ]
        ring
      _ = fTerm w (n + 1) := by
        rw [F_ode_coefficient]
        simp [fTerm, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
  rw [hfun] at hcombined
  have hcombinedEq := hcombined.tsum_eq
  have hFSplit := (fTerm_summable w).sum_add_tsum_nat_add 1
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_one, fTerm, pow_zero, Nat.factorial_zero,
    Nat.cast_one, one_pow, div_one] at hFSplit
  change (1 : ℂ) + (∑' n : ℕ, fTerm w (n + 1)) = F w at hFSplit
  linear_combination hFSplit - hcombinedEq

theorem FRay_ode (hode : FODEStatement) (a : ℂ) (s : ℝ) :
    (s : ℂ) * FRayAccel a s + FRaySlope a s = a * FRay a s := by
  have h := hode.2.2 ((s : ℂ) * a)
  dsimp only [FRayAccel, FRaySlope, FRay]
  linear_combination a * h

theorem FRayNormSq_hasDerivAt (a : ℂ) (s : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (FRayNormSq a) (2 * inner ℝ (FRay a s) (FRaySlope a s)) s :=
  (FRay_hasDerivAt a s).norm_sq

@[simp] theorem FRayNormSq_deriv (a : ℂ) (s : ℝ) :
    deriv (FRayNormSq a) s = 2 * inner ℝ (FRay a s) (FRaySlope a s) :=
  (FRayNormSq_hasDerivAt a s).deriv

theorem FRayFlux_eq (a : ℂ) (s : ℝ) :
    FRayFlux a s = s * deriv (FRayNormSq a) s := by
  rw [FRayNormSq_deriv]
  rfl

@[simp] theorem FRayFlux_zero (a : ℂ) : FRayFlux a 0 = 0 := by simp [FRayFlux]

theorem FRayFlux_hasDerivAt (hode : FODEStatement) (a : ℂ) (s : ℝ) :

      (2 * (s * ‖FRaySlope a s‖ ^ 2 + a.re * ‖FRay a s‖ ^ 2)) s := by
  have hi := (FRay_hasDerivAt a s).inner ℝ (FRaySlope_hasDerivAt a s)
  have hd := (hasDerivAt_id s).mul (hi.const_mul 2)
  have hscalar : inner ℝ (FRay a s) ((s : ℂ) * FRayAccel a s) =
      s * inner ℝ (FRay a s) (FRayAccel a s) := by
    change inner ℝ (FRay a s) (s • FRayAccel a s) =
      s * inner ℝ (FRay a s) (FRayAccel a s)
    exact real_inner_smul_right _ _ _
  have he : s * inner ℝ (FRay a s) (FRayAccel a s) +
      inner ℝ (FRay a s) (FRaySlope a s) = a.re * ‖FRay a s‖ ^ 2 := by
    have he' := congrArg (fun v : ℂ => inner ℝ (FRay a s) v) (FRay_ode hode a s)
    simpa only [inner_add_right, hscalar, real_inner_complex_mul_self] using he'
  have hval :
      2 * inner ℝ (FRay a s) (FRaySlope a s) +
        s * (2 * (inner ℝ (FRay a s) (FRayAccel a s) +

      2 * (s * ‖FRaySlope a s‖ ^ 2 + a.re * ‖FRay a s‖ ^ 2) := by

entries.title: 能量正性与严格径向增长
entries.source_excerpt:
The integrand is nonnegative for $u\ge0$.  Since $h'(0)=w\ne0$, its first
term is positive for all sufficiently small $u>0$.  Thus $Y'(s)>0$ for
every $s>0$, and $|F(w)|^2=Y(1)>Y(0)=1$.
entries.mathematical_meaning: 积分被积函数非负；h′(0)=w≠0使u|h′(u)|²在足够小u>0严格为正。因此∀s>0，Y′(s)>0，最终|F(w)|²=Y(1)>Y(0)=1。
assumptions_and_quantifiers: 固定w≠0，Re w≥0；u≥0；正性用h′连续性；∀s>0。
entries.bridges: h′(0)=w由FRaySlope_zero，连续性给0邻域非零；正积分使用该邻域中的正点及非负被积函数。两个_of_ode根均取F_ode_statement，未留下解析输入。严格单调在[0,∞)上给Y(1)>Y(0)。

theorem FRaySlope_exists_nonzero (a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) :
    ∃ u : ℝ, 0 < u ∧ u ≤ s ∧ FRaySlope a u ≠ 0 := by
  have hzero : FRaySlope a 0 ≠ 0 := by simpa only [FRaySlope_zero] using ha
  have hnear : ∀ᶠ u : ℝ in 𝓝 0, FRaySlope a u ≠ 0 :=
    (FRaySlope_hasDerivAt a 0).continuousAt.eventually_ne hzero
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hnear
  let u : ℝ := min (s / 2) (ε / 2)
  have hu : 0 < u := lt_min (half_pos hs) (half_pos hε)
  have hus : u ≤ s := (min_le_left _ _).trans (by linarith)
  have hue : u < ε := (min_le_right _ _).trans_lt (by linarith)
  have huball : u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) ε := by
    simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hu] using hue
  exact ⟨u, hu, hus, hsub huball⟩

      (u * ‖FRaySlope a u‖ ^ 2 + a.re * ‖FRay a u‖ ^ 2) := by
  have hRay : Continuous (FRay a) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun u => (FRay_hasDerivAt a u).continuousAt)
  have hSlope : Continuous (FRaySlope a) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun u => (FRaySlope_hasDerivAt a u).continuousAt)
  have hg : Continuous (fun u : ℝ =>
      u * ‖FRaySlope a u‖ ^ 2 + a.re * ‖FRay a u‖ ^ 2) :=
    (continuous_id.mul (hSlope.norm.pow 2)).add
      (continuous_const.mul (hRay.norm.pow 2))
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hus, hne⟩ := FRaySlope_exists_nonzero a ha s hs
  have hvalue : 0 < u * ‖FRaySlope a u‖ ^ 2 + a.re * ‖FRay a u‖ ^ 2 :=
    add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg

theorem laplace_compactified_ne_zero {w : ℂ} (hw : w ∈ Complex.slitPlane)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ((2 * (1 - s) : ℝ) : ℂ) * w + (s : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
  by_cases he : s = 1
  · simp [he]
  have hsp : 0 < 1 - s := sub_pos.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne hs.2 he)
  rcases hw with hr | hi
  · have hpos : 0 < (((2 * (1 - s) : ℝ) : ℂ) * w + (s : ℂ)).re := by
      simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
        Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]
      exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (mul_pos (by positivity) hr) hs.1
    intro hz
    rw [hz] at hpos
    norm_num at hpos
  · have him : (((2 * (1 - s) : ℝ) : ℂ) * w + (s : ℂ)).im ≠ 0 := by
      simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
        Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero]
      exact mul_ne_zero (by positivity) hi
    intro hz
    apply him
    rw [hz]
    rfl

theorem laplace_compact_uniform_lower {L : Set ℂ} (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hsub : L ⊆ Complex.slitPlane) :
    ∃ m c : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ 0 < c ∧
      (∀ w ∈ L, m ≤ ‖w‖) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ L, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → c ≤ ‖1 + (t : ℂ) / (2 * w)‖) := by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmb⟩ := hL.exists_forall_le' continuous_norm.continuousOn
    (fun w hw => norm_pos_iff.mpr (Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero (hsub hw)))
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hMb⟩ := hL.isBounded.exists_pos_norm_le
  have hprod : IsCompact (L ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := hL.prod isCompact_Icc
  have hcont : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℝ =>
      ‖((2 * (1 - p.2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * p.1 + (p.2 : ℂ)‖) := by fun_prop
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hηb⟩ := hprod.exists_forall_le' hcont.continuousOn
    (fun p hp => norm_pos_iff.mpr (laplace_compactified_ne_zero (hsub hp.1) hp.2))
  refine ⟨m, η / (2 * M), hm, by positivity, hmb, ?_⟩

entries.title: 紧集上的核与导数可积控制
entries.source_excerpt:
$1=0$, or $w=-s/[2(1-s)]\in(-\infty,0]$.  Taking $s=t/(1+t)$ shows that
\[
   \left|1+\frac{t}{2w}\right|\ge c_L:=\frac{\eta_L}{2M_L}>0
   \qquad(w\in L,\ t\ge0).
\]
The kernel is therefore bounded on $L$ by $c_L^{-1/2}$.  Its derivative is
\[
   \frac{\partial}{\partial w}
   \left(1+\frac{t}{2w}\right)^{-1/2}
   =\frac{t}{4w^2}\left(1+\frac{t}{2w}\right)^{-3/2},
\]
whose modulus is at most $t c_L^{-3/2}/(4m_L^2)$.  The mass and first
moment of $\mu$ now justify differentiation under the integral sign.
assumptions_and_quantifiers: 固定上述L及常数；∀w∈L，∀t≥0；导数与负幂使用主值分支。
entries.bridges: c确切取η/(2M)；局部证明s=t/(1+t)、he给紧化代数关系，hbase给底数除法关系。Revision内部K=c^(-1/2)、B=(4m²)^(-1)c^(-3/2)是原文两个显式界；返回共同C=1+K+B只是对它们增强包装。这里未把C/Ct自行当作加权可积性。

  intro w hw t ht
  have hwpos : 0 < ‖w‖ := lt_of_lt_of_le hm (hmb w hw)
  have hwnz : w ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hwpos
  have ht1 : 0 < 1 + t := by linarith
  let s : ℝ := t / (1 + t)
  have hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    refine ⟨div_nonneg ht ht1.le, (div_le_one ht1).mpr ?_⟩
    linarith
  have hηw := hηb (w, s) ⟨hw, hs⟩
  have he : 2 * w + (t : ℂ) = ((1 + t : ℝ) : ℂ) *

    push_cast
    have htc : (1 : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ht1.ne'

    field_simp

  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * M)
    (by positivity : 0 < 2 * ‖w‖)).mpr

    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN hM.le]

obtain ⟨m, c, hm, hc, hmb, hcb⟩ := laplace_compact_uniform_lower hL hsub
  let K : ℝ := Real.rpow c (-1 / 2 : ℝ)
  let B : ℝ := (1 / (4 * m ^ 2)) * Real.rpow c (-3 / 2 : ℝ)
  let C : ℝ := 1 + K + B
  have hK : 0 < K := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hc _
  have hB : 0 < B := by dsimp [B]; positivity
  have hC : 0 < C := by dsimp [C]; linarith
  have hKC : K ≤ C := by dsimp [C]; linarith
  have hBC : B ≤ C := by dsimp [C]; linarith
  refine ⟨m, c, C, hm, hc, hC, ?_⟩
  intro w hw t ht
  have hb : c ≤ ‖laplaceBase w t‖ := hcb w hw t ht
  have hwpos : 0 < ‖w‖ := hm.trans_le (hmb w hw)
  have hinv : ‖(1 / (4 * w ^ 2) : ℂ)‖ ≤ (1 / (4 * m ^ 2) : ℝ) := by
    simp only [norm_div, norm_one, norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_ofNat]
    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * m ^ 2)
    nlinarith [hmb w hw]
  have hmoment := laplaceMomentKernel_norm_le_of_base_lower_bound ht hc hb
  refine ⟨hmb w hw, hb,
    (laplaceKernel_norm_le_of_base_lower_bound hc hb).trans hKC,
    laplaceKernel_hasDerivAt_moment (hsub hw) ht, ?_⟩
  calc
    ‖(1 / (4 * w ^ 2) : ℂ) * laplaceMomentKernel w t‖ =
        ‖(1 / (4 * w ^ 2) : ℂ)‖ * ‖laplaceMomentKernel w t‖ := norm_mul _ _
    _ ≤ (1 / (4 * m ^ 2)) * (t * Real.rpow c (-3 / 2 : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul hinv hmoment (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    _ = B * t := by dsimp [B]; ring
    _ ≤ C * t := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hBC ht

entries.title: 积分号下求导与全纯性
entries.source_excerpt:
whose modulus is at most $t c_L^{-3/2}/(4m_L^2)$.  The mass and first
moment of $\mu$ now justify differentiation under the integral sign.
This proves the holomorphy of $\mathcal I$ and its derivative formula;
the defining prefactor then gives the holomorphy of $\mathcal K$.
entries.mathematical_meaning: μ的有限质量和一阶矩为核及导数提供可积上界，允许积分号下求导并证明I全纯及其导数公式；Kcal的全纯前因子使Kcal全纯。
assumptions_and_quantifiers: 任意紧L⊂Ω；核逐点全纯及局部统一可积控制如前。
entries.bridges: 可积majorant明确是K·μ(t)及B·tμ(t)，不是未加权的C/Ct。muDensity_integrableOn及firstMoment_integrableOn提供真实积分输入；LaplaceAnalytic的mono'、hmeas、hdmeas、hBint和hdiff完成Bochner及求导条件。laplaceI_hasDerivAt真实调用参数积分求导定理；K前因子的底数仍在slitPlane。

theorem laplace_weighted_kernel_integrable {w : ℂ} (hw : w ∈ Complex.slitPlane) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t => (muDensity t : ℂ) * laplaceKernel w t) (Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
  obtain ⟨r, m, c, hr, hm, hc, hsub, hmb, hcb⟩ := laplace_local_uniform_lower hw
  apply (muDensity_integrableOn.mul_const (Real.rpow c (-1 / 2 : ℝ))).mono'
    (laplace_weighted_kernel_measurable hw)
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
  rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (muDensity_nonneg t ht.le)]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (laplaceKernel_norm_le_of_base_lower_bound hc
      (hcb w (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr.le) t ht.le)) (muDensity_nonneg t ht.le)

theorem laplace_weighted_moment_integrable {w : ℂ} (hw : w ∈ Complex.slitPlane) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t => (muDensity t : ℂ) * laplaceMomentKernel w t) (Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
  obtain ⟨r, m, c, hr, hm, hc, hsub, hmb, hcb⟩ := laplace_local_uniform_lower hw
  apply (firstMoment_integrableOn.mul_const (Real.rpow c (-3 / 2 : ℝ))).mono'
    (laplace_weighted_moment_measurable hw)
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
  rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (muDensity_nonneg t ht.le)]
  calc
    _ ≤ muDensity t * (t * Real.rpow c (-3 / 2 : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (laplaceMomentKernel_norm_le_of_base_lower_bound ht.le hc
          (hcb w (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr.le) t ht.le)) (muDensity_nonneg t ht.le)
    _ = _ := by ring

theorem laplaceI_hasDerivAt {w : ℂ} (hw : w ∈ Complex.slitPlane) :
    HasDerivAt laplaceI ((1 / (4 * w ^ 2)) * weightedIntegral (laplaceMomentKernel w)) w := by
  obtain ⟨r, m, c, hr, hm, hc, hsub, hmb, hcb⟩ := laplace_local_uniform_lower hw
  let P : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun z t => (muDensity t : ℂ) * laplaceKernel z t
  let D : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun z t =>
    (muDensity t : ℂ) * ((1 / (4 * z ^ 2)) * laplaceMomentKernel z t)
  let B : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    (1 / (4 * m ^ 2)) * Real.rpow c (-3 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * muDensity t)
  have hmeas : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 w, AEStronglyMeasurable (P z)
      (volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))) := by
    filter_upwards [Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds w hr] with z hz
    exact laplace_weighted_kernel_measurable (hsub hz)
  have hdmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (D w) (volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))) := by
    have hh := (laplace_weighted_moment_measurable hw).const_mul (1 / (4 * w ^ 2))
    convert hh using 1
    funext t
    dsimp [D]
    ring
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ)),
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall w r, ‖D z t‖ ≤ B t := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
    intro z hz
    have hμ := muDensity_nonneg t ht.le
    have hmz := hmb z hz
    have hzpos : 0 < ‖z‖ := hm.trans_le hmz
    have hinv : 1 / (4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2) ≤ 1 / (4 * m ^ 2) := by
      apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
      nlinarith
    have hmoment := laplaceMomentKernel_norm_le_of_base_lower_bound ht.le hc (hcb z hz t ht.le)
    dsimp only [D, B]
    rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hμ]
    have hnorm : ‖1 / (4 * z ^ 2)‖ = 1 / (4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2) := by simp
    rw [hnorm]
    calc
      _ ≤ muDensity t * ((1 / (4 * m ^ 2)) *
          (t * Real.rpow c (-3 / 2 : ℝ))) := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hBint : Integrable B (volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))) :=
    firstMoment_integrableOn.const_mul _
  have hdiff : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ)),
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall w r, HasDerivAt (P · t) (D z t) z := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
    intro z hz
    exact (laplaceKernel_hasDerivAt_moment (hsub hz) ht.le).const_mul (muDensity t : ℂ)
  have hd := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (μ := volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))) (Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds w hr)
    hmeas (laplace_weighted_kernel_integrable hw) hdmeas hbound hBint hdiff
  have hvalue : (∫ t, D w t ∂volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))) =
      (1 / (4 * w ^ 2)) * weightedIntegral (laplaceMomentKernel w) := by
    rw [weightedIntegral, ← integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => by dsimp [D]; ring)
  rw [hvalue] at hd
  exact hd.2

theorem laplaceK_differentiableAt {w : ℂ} (hw : w ∈ Complex.slitPlane) :
    DifferentiableAt ℂ laplaceK w := by
  have hwn : w ≠ 0 := Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero hw
  have hd : (2 : ℂ) * w ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hwn
  have hbase : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => (Real.pi : ℂ) / (2 * z)) w :=
    ((hasDerivAt_const w (Real.pi : ℂ)).div ((hasDerivAt_id w).const_mul 2) hd).differentiableAt
  have hslit : (Real.pi : ℂ) / (2 * w) ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
    convert positive_div_mem_slitPlane hw (div_pos Real.pi_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)) using 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have hp := hbase.cpow_const (c := (1 / 2 : ℂ)) hslit
  have he : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => Complex.exp (-z)) w := by fun_prop
  have hh := (hp.mul he).mul (laplaceI_hasDerivAt hw).differentiableAt
  exact hh

theorem laplaceK_differentiableOn : DifferentiableOn ℂ laplaceK Complex.slitPlane :=
  fun _ hw => (laplaceK_differentiableAt hw).differentiableWithinAt

theorem muDensity_integrableOn : IntegrableOn muDensity (Ioi (0 : ℝ)) volume := by
  have h : IntegrableOn
      (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-t) * Real.rpow t (-1 / 2 : ℝ)) (Ioi 0) volume := by
    simpa only [Real.rpow_eq_pow, show (1 / 2 : ℝ) - 1 = -1 / 2 by norm_num] using
      (Real.GammaIntegral_convergent (s := (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (by norm_num))
  change IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ =>
    Real.exp (-t) * Real.rpow t (-1 / 2 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt Real.pi) (Ioi 0) volume
  exact h.div_const (Real.sqrt Real.pi)

theorem firstMoment_density_eq {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    t * muDensity t =
      Real.exp (-t) * Real.rpow t (1 / 2 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt Real.pi := by
  have hp : Real.rpow t (1 / 2 : ℝ) = Real.rpow t (-1 / 2 : ℝ) * t := by
    simpa only [Real.rpow_eq_pow, show (-1 / 2 : ℝ) + 1 = 1 / 2 by norm_num] using
      (Real.rpow_add_one (ne_of_gt ht) (-1 / 2 : ℝ))
  rw [muDensity, hp]
  ring

theorem firstMoment_integrableOn :
    IntegrableOn (fun t => t * muDensity t) (Ioi (0 : ℝ)) volume := by
  have h : IntegrableOn
      (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-t) * Real.rpow t (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (Ioi 0) volume := by
    simpa only [Real.rpow_eq_pow, show (3 / 2 : ℝ) - 1 = 1 / 2 by norm_num] using
      (Real.GammaIntegral_convergent (s := (3 / 2 : ℝ)) (by norm_num))
  have hdiv : IntegrableOn
      (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-t) * Real.rpow t (1 / 2 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt Real.pi)
      (Ioi 0) volume := h.div_const (Real.sqrt Real.pi)
  apply hdiv.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Ioi
  intro t ht
  exact (firstMoment_density_eq ht).symm

entries.title: 正实轴上K0的标准积分表示
entries.source_excerpt:
For $w>0$, the standard representation \cite[10.32.9]{DLMF}
\[
   K_0(w)=\int_0^\infty e^{-w\cosh u}\,du
\]
entries.bridges: 对实际独立K0Series和实x>0给cosh积分等式，并额外给绝对可积性；复值被积函数在实参数下与原实表达式一致。

theorem complexCoshKernel_integrable {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(x : ℂ) * (Real.cosh u : ℂ))) (Ioi 0) := by
  have hi : IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => (Real.exp (-x * Real.cosh u) : ℂ)) (Ioi 0) :=
    (realCoshKernel_integrable hx).ofReal
  exact hi.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (realCoshKernel_ofReal x))

theorem K0Series_ofReal_cosh_integral {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    K0Series (x : ℂ) =
      ∫ u : ℝ in Ioi 0, Complex.exp (-(x : ℂ) * (Real.cosh u : ℂ)) := by
  calc
    _ = laplaceK (x : ℂ) := (laplaceK_eq_K0Series_positive_real hx).symm
    _ = ((∫ v : ℝ in Ioi 1, positiveSpectralKernel x v : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
      laplaceK_ofReal_spectral_integral hx
    _ = ((∫ u : ℝ in Ioi 0, Real.exp (-x * Real.cosh u) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [positiveSpectralKernel_integral_eq_cosh]
    _ = _ := by
      have hcast : (∫ u : ℝ in Ioi 0, (Real.exp (-x * Real.cosh u) : ℂ)) =
          ((∫ u : ℝ in Ioi 0, Real.exp (-x * Real.cosh u) : ℝ) : ℂ) := integral_ofReal
      calc
        _ = ∫ u : ℝ in Ioi 0, (Real.exp (-x * Real.cosh u) : ℂ) := hcast.symm
        _ = _ := by
          apply integral_congr_ae
          exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (realCoshKernel_ofReal x)

/-- The independent paper-facing integral identity and its actual absolute
convergence, with exactly the original positive-real hypothesis. -/
theorem paper_k0_cosh_integral : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
    IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(x : ℂ) * (Real.cosh u : ℂ))) (Ioi 0) ∧
      K0Series (x : ℂ) =
        ∫ u : ℝ in Ioi 0, Complex.exp (-(x : ℂ) * (Real.cosh u : ℂ)) := by
  intro x hx
  exact ⟨complexCoshKernel_integrable hx, K0Series_ofReal_cosh_integral hx⟩

entries.title: 正实轴换元识别Kcal
entries.source_excerpt:
and the substitution $t=w(\cosh u-1)$ give
\[
   K_0(w)=e^{-w}\int_0^\infty
   \frac{e^{-t}}{\sqrt{t(2w+t)}}\,dt=\mathcal K(w).
\]
assumptions_and_quantifiers: ∀实w>0；实正平方根与主值平方根一致。
entries.bridges: 实际证明把同一换元分成v=cosh u和t=x(v-1)两步，其复合正是t=x(cosh u-1)。两步image、injectivity、导数和端点Jacobian均实际证明；realLaplaceKernel=exp(-x-t)/sqrt(t(2x+t))。因此等于原文exp(-x)外提的积分，并与laplaceK定义相同；正实识别根解除K0Series/laplaceK差异。

theorem positiveLaplaceWeight_eq_realLaplaceKernel {x t : ℝ}
    (hx : 0 < x) (ht : 0 < t) :
    positiveLaplaceWeight x t = realLaplaceKernel x t := by
  have hb : 0 < 1 + t / (2 * x) := by positivity
  have hbase : 1 + t / (2 * x) = (2 * x + t) / (2 * x) := by
    field_simp [hx.ne'] <;> ring
  have hp : Real.sqrt Real.pi ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr Real.pi_pos).ne'
  have hxroot : Real.sqrt (2 * x) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)).ne'
  have htroot : Real.sqrt t ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr ht).ne'
  have hsumroot : Real.sqrt (2 * x + t) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)).ne'
  unfold positiveLaplaceWeight realLaplacePrefactor realLaplaceAmplitude
    muDensity realLaplaceKernel
  rw [real_rpow_neg_half_eq_inv_sqrt ht.le, real_rpow_neg_half_eq_inv_sqrt hb.le,
    Real.sqrt_div Real.pi_pos.le (2 * x), hbase,
    Real.sqrt_div (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * x + t) (2 * x),
    Real.sqrt_mul ht.le (2 * x + t)]
  rw [show -x - t = -x + -t by ring, Real.exp_add]
  field_simp [hp, hxroot, htroot, hsumroot] <;> ring

theorem laplaceK_ofReal_kernel_integral {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    laplaceK (x : ℂ) = ((∫ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, realLaplaceKernel x t : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  rw [laplaceK_ofReal_weight_integral hx]
  congr 1
  apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
  intro t ht
  exact positiveLaplaceWeight_eq_realLaplaceKernel hx ht

theorem realLaplaceKernel_affine {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (v : ℝ) :
    x * realLaplaceKernel x (x * (v - 1)) = positiveSpectralKernel x v := by
  have hpoly : (x * (v - 1)) * (2 * x + x * (v - 1)) = x ^ 2 * (v ^ 2 - 1) := by ring
  have hroot : Real.sqrt ((x * (v - 1)) * (2 * x + x * (v - 1))) =
      x * Real.sqrt (v ^ 2 - 1) := by
    rw [hpoly, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg x), Real.sqrt_sq hx.le]
  unfold realLaplaceKernel positiveSpectralKernel
  rw [hroot, show -x - x * (v - 1) = -x * v by ring,
    ← mul_div_assoc, mul_div_mul_left _ _ hx.ne']

theorem positiveLaplace_affine_image {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    (fun v : ℝ => x * (v - 1)) '' Ioi (1 : ℝ) = Ioi (0 : ℝ) := by
  ext t
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    exact mul_pos hx (sub_pos.mpr hv)
  · intro ht
    change 0 < t at ht
    refine ⟨t / x + 1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hpos : 0 < t / x := div_pos ht hx
      change 1 < t / x + 1
      linarith
    · field_simp [hx.ne'] <;> ring

theorem positiveLaplace_affine_hasDerivAt (x v : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => x * (u - 1)) x v := by
  convert! ((hasDerivAt_id v).sub_const 1).const_mul x using 1 <;> simp <;> ring

theorem positiveLaplace_affine_injOn {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    InjOn (fun v : ℝ => x * (v - 1)) (Ioi (1 : ℝ)) := by
  intro u _ v _ heq
  have heq' := mul_left_cancel₀ hx.ne' heq
  linarith

/-- Absolute convergence at the square-root singular endpoint v=1. -/
theorem positiveSpectralKernel_integrable {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    IntegrableOn (positiveSpectralKernel x) (Ioi (1 : ℝ)) := by
  have hchange := integrableOn_image_iff_integrableOn_abs_deriv_smul
    measurableSet_Ioi
    (fun v _ => (positiveLaplace_affine_hasDerivAt x v).hasDerivWithinAt)
    (positiveLaplace_affine_injOn hx) (realLaplaceKernel x)
  rw [positiveLaplace_affine_image hx] at hchange
  have h := hchange.mp (realLaplaceKernel_integrable hx)
  apply h.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Ioi
  intro v _
  simpa only [abs_of_pos hx, smul_eq_mul] using realLaplaceKernel_affine hx v

theorem realLaplaceKernel_integral_eq_spectral {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, realLaplaceKernel x t) =
      ∫ v : ℝ in Ioi 1, positiveSpectralKernel x v := by
  have h := integral_image_eq_integral_abs_deriv_smul measurableSet_Ioi
    (fun v _ => (positiveLaplace_affine_hasDerivAt x v).hasDerivWithinAt)
    (positiveLaplace_affine_injOn hx) (realLaplaceKernel x)
  rw [positiveLaplace_affine_image hx] at h
  calc
    (∫ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, realLaplaceKernel x t) =
        ∫ v : ℝ in Ioi 1, |x| • realLaplaceKernel x (x * (v - 1)) := h
    _ = ∫ v : ℝ in Ioi 1, positiveSpectralKernel x v := by
      apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      intro v _
      simpa only [abs_of_pos hx, smul_eq_mul] using realLaplaceKernel_affine hx v

theorem positiveCosh_image : Real.cosh '' Ioi (0 : ℝ) = Ioi (1 : ℝ) := by
  ext v
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    exact Real.one_lt_cosh.mpr (ne_of_gt hu)
  · intro hv
    exact ⟨Real.arcosh v, Real.arcosh_pos hv, Real.cosh_arcosh hv.le⟩

theorem positiveCosh_injOn : InjOn Real.cosh (Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :=
  Real.cosh_injOn.mono Ioi_subset_Ici_self

theorem positiveCosh_sqrt_jacobian {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) :
    Real.sqrt (Real.cosh u ^ 2 - 1) = Real.sinh u := by
  rw [← Real.sinh_sq, Real.sqrt_sq (Real.sinh_pos_iff.mpr hu).le]

/-- Cancellation is used only where the derivative `sinh u` is positive. -/
theorem positiveSpectralKernel_cosh_jacobian (x : ℝ) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) :
    |Real.sinh u| • positiveSpectralKernel x (Real.cosh u) =
      Real.exp (-x * Real.cosh u) := by
  have hs : 0 < Real.sinh u := Real.sinh_pos_iff.mpr hu
  unfold positiveSpectralKernel
  rw [abs_of_pos hs, smul_eq_mul, positiveCosh_sqrt_jacobian hu]
  field_simp [hs.ne'] <;> ring

/-- Absolute convergence follows from the already proved actual spectral
integral and the genuine unbounded-domain Jacobian equivalence. -/
theorem realCoshKernel_integrable {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-x * Real.cosh u)) (Ioi 0) := by
  have hchange := integrableOn_image_iff_integrableOn_abs_deriv_smul
    measurableSet_Ioi (fun u _ => (Real.hasDerivAt_cosh u).hasDerivWithinAt)
    positiveCosh_injOn (positiveSpectralKernel x)
  rw [positiveCosh_image] at hchange
  apply (hchange.mp (positiveSpectralKernel_integrable hx)).congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Ioi
  intro u hu
  exact positiveSpectralKernel_cosh_jacobian x hu

theorem positiveSpectralKernel_integral_eq_cosh (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ v : ℝ in Ioi 1, positiveSpectralKernel x v) =
      ∫ u : ℝ in Ioi 0, Real.exp (-x * Real.cosh u) := by
  have hchange := integral_image_eq_integral_abs_deriv_smul
    measurableSet_Ioi (fun u _ => (Real.hasDerivAt_cosh u).hasDerivWithinAt)
    positiveCosh_injOn (positiveSpectralKernel x)
  rw [positiveCosh_image] at hchange
  calc
    _ = ∫ u : ℝ in Ioi 0, |Real.sinh u| • positiveSpectralKernel x (Real.cosh u) := hchange
    _ = _ := by
      apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      intro u hu
      exact positiveSpectralKernel_cosh_jacobian x hu

entries.title: 恒等定理延拓到Ω
entries.source_excerpt:
The principal branch of $K_0$ is holomorphic on $\Omega$
\cite[Sec.~10.25(ii)]{DLMF}.  Since $\Omega$ is connected, the identity
theorem yields $\mathcal K=K_0$ throughout $\Omega$.
entries.mathematical_meaning: K0主值分支在Ω全纯，Ω连通，Kcal与K0在正实轴一致，恒等定理推出两者在全Ω一致。
assumptions_and_quantifiers: Ω=C\(−∞,0]；Kcal已证全纯；正实轴有Ω内聚点。
entries.source_basis: article argument using externally cited K0 holomorphy: DLMF 10.25(ii)
entries.bridges: 通用hpos明确取(fun _ hx=>laplaceK_eq_K0Series_positive_real hx)，实际在k_laplace_identification中供给。连通性通过slitPlane对1星凸；积聚点取1，正实序列1+1/(n+1)构造频繁相等条件，故未把奇异点0误作恒等定理初值。

theorem laplaceIdentification_of_positive_real
    (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → laplaceK (x : ℂ) = K0Series (x : ℂ)) :
    KLaplaceIdentificationStatement := by
  have hk := laplaceK_differentiableOn.analyticOnNhd Complex.isOpen_slitPlane
  have hs := K0Series_analyticOnNhd
  have hc : IsPreconnected Complex.slitPlane :=
    (Complex.starConvex_one_slitPlane.isPathConnected (by simp)).isConnected.isPreconnected
  let u : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => ((1 + (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)
  have hu : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 (1 : ℂ)) := by
    have hr : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 1 + (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1))) atTop (𝓝 (1 : ℝ)) := by
      simpa only [add_zero] using
        (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1 : ℝ))).add tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
    exact hr.ofReal
  have hun : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, u n ∈ ({(1 : ℂ)} : Set ℂ)ᶜ := by
    filter_upwards [] with n
    change u n ≠ 1
    intro he
    have he' := congrArg Complex.re he
    dsimp [u] at he'
    change (1 + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) = 1 at he'
    have hp : 0 < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hup : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝[≠] (1 : ℂ)) :=
    tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hu, hun⟩
  have he : ∃ᶠ z : ℂ in 𝓝[≠] (1 : ℂ), laplaceK z = K0Series z := by
    apply hup.frequently
    apply Filter.Eventually.frequently
    filter_upwards [] with n
    exact hpos _ (by positivity)
  exact hk.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq hs hc (by simp) he

theorem k_laplace_identification : KLaplaceIdentificationStatement :=
  laplaceIdentification_of_positive_real (fun _ hx => laplaceK_eq_K0Series_positive_real hx)

entries.title: 旋转后的主值对数恒等式
entries.source_excerpt:
Write $z=re^{i\theta}$ with $-\pi/2<\theta<\pi/2$.  Then
\[
   \Log(iz)=\Log z+\frac{\pi i}{2},
   \qquad
   \Log(-iz)=\Log z-\frac{\pi i}{2},
\]
entries.bridges: 实际前提是Re(z)>0，证明中取得严格±π/2参数界并验证Log乘法的总Arg区间，故不是无条件Log乘法。

theorem log_I_mul_rightHalf {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    Complex.log (Complex.I * z) = Complex.log z + (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I / 2 := by
  have hz0 := rightHalfPlane_ne_zero hz
  have hlo : -(Real.pi / 2) < z.arg :=
    Complex.neg_pi_div_two_lt_arg_iff.mpr (Or.inl hz)
  have hhi : z.arg < Real.pi / 2 :=
    Complex.arg_lt_pi_div_two_iff.mpr (Or.inl hz)
  have hb : Complex.I.arg + z.arg ∈ Set.Ioc (-Real.pi) Real.pi := by
    rw [Complex.arg_I]
    constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  calc
    Complex.log (Complex.I * z) = Complex.log Complex.I + Complex.log z :=
      Complex.log_mul Complex.I_ne_zero hz0 hb
    _ = Complex.log z + (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I / 2 := by
      rw [Complex.log_I]
      ring

theorem log_negI_mul_rightHalf {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    Complex.log (-Complex.I * z) = Complex.log z - (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I / 2 := by
  have hz0 := rightHalfPlane_ne_zero hz
  have hlo : -(Real.pi / 2) < z.arg :=
    Complex.neg_pi_div_two_lt_arg_iff.mpr (Or.inl hz)
  have hhi : z.arg < Real.pi / 2 :=
    Complex.arg_lt_pi_div_two_iff.mpr (Or.inl hz)
  have hb : (-Complex.I).arg + z.arg ∈ Set.Ioc (-Real.pi) Real.pi := by
    rw [Complex.arg_neg_I]
    constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  calc
    Complex.log (-Complex.I * z) = Complex.log (-Complex.I) + Complex.log z :=
      Complex.log_mul (neg_ne_zero.mpr Complex.I_ne_zero) hz0 hb
    _ = Complex.log z - (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I / 2 := by
      rw [Complex.log_neg_I]
      ring

entries.title: K0(±iz)的精确振幅表达
entries.source_excerpt:
Proposition~\ref{prop:K-Laplace} gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
   K_0(-iz)&=\sqrt{\frac\pi2}\,e^{\pi i/4}z^{-1/2}e^{iz}A_+(z),\\
   K_0(iz)&=\sqrt{\frac\pi2}\,e^{-\pi i/4}z^{-1/2}e^{-iz}A_-(z).
\end{aligned}
\]
entries.bridges: 真实局部hplus/hminus给laplaceK(∓iz)=P/M·exp(±iz)·A±；hident明确由k_laplace_identification解除。P/M是实际主平方根前因子。两个prefactor product根给P·D=πexp(iπ/4)、M·D=πexp(-iπ/4)，D=sqrt(2πz)非零；除以D并用两个已证Log缩放式，等价于原文sqrt(π/2)·z^(-1/2)的写法。不是只用最终J0分解冒充该中间式。

let D : ℂ := Complex.cpow (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * z) (1 / 2 : ℂ)
  let P : ℂ := Complex.cpow ((Real.pi : ℂ) / (2 * (-Complex.I * z))) (1 / 2 : ℂ)
  let M : ℂ := Complex.cpow ((Real.pi : ℂ) / (2 * (Complex.I * z))) (1 / 2 : ℂ)
  have hplus : laplaceK (-Complex.I * z) = P * Complex.exp (Complex.I * z) * APlus z := by
    unfold laplaceK
    rw [← APlus_eq_laplaceI]
    simp only [P, neg_mul, neg_neg]
  have hminus : laplaceK (Complex.I * z) = M * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * z) * AMinus z := by
    unfold laplaceK
    rw [← AMinus_eq_laplaceI]
    simp only [M, neg_mul]
  have hconn := K0_connection z hz
  rw [← hident _ (negI_mul_mem_slitPlane hz), ← hident _ (I_mul_mem_slitPlane hz),
    hplus, hminus] at hconn
  have hP : P * D = (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4) :=
    laplace_prefactor_plus_product hz
  have hM : M * D = (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4) :=
    laplace_prefactor_minus_product hz

have hD : D ≠ 0 := Complex.cpow_ne_zero_iff.mpr (Or.inl
    (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (2 : ℂ) ≠ 0)
      (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero)) (rightHalfPlane_ne_zero hz)))

theorem laplace_prefactor_plus_product {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    Complex.cpow ((Real.pi : ℂ) / (2 * (-Complex.I * z))) (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
      Complex.cpow (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * z) (1 / 2 : ℂ) =
        (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4) := by
  have hz0 := rightHalfPlane_ne_zero hz
  have hpi0 : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero
  have hw0 : -Complex.I * z ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr Complex.I_ne_zero) hz0
  have hp0 : (Real.pi : ℂ) / (2 * (-Complex.I * z)) ≠ 0 :=
    div_ne_zero hpi0 (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hw0)
  have hD0 : 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * z ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hpi0) hz0
  change ((Real.pi : ℂ) / (2 * (-Complex.I * z))) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
    (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * z) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) = _
  rw [Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero hp0, Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero hD0,
    ← Complex.exp_add, log_pi_div_two_mul (negI_mul_mem_slitPlane hz),
    log_two_pi_mul hz0, log_negI_mul_rightHalf hz]
  calc
    _ = Complex.exp ((Real.log Real.pi : ℂ) + Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4) := by
      congr 1
      linear_combination (1 / 2 : ℂ) * log_pi_halves_sum
    _ = (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4) := by
      rw [Complex.exp_add, ← Complex.ofReal_exp, Real.exp_log Real.pi_pos]

theorem laplace_prefactor_minus_product {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    Complex.cpow ((Real.pi : ℂ) / (2 * (Complex.I * z))) (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
      Complex.cpow (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * z) (1 / 2 : ℂ) =
        (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4) := by
  have hz0 := rightHalfPlane_ne_zero hz
  have hpi0 : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero

    div_ne_zero hpi0 (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hw0)
  have hD0 : 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * z ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hpi0) hz0

    (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * z) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) = _

    ← Complex.exp_add, log_pi_div_two_mul (I_mul_mem_slitPlane hz),
    log_two_pi_mul hz0, log_I_mul_rightHalf hz]
  calc
    _ = Complex.exp ((Real.log Real.pi : ℂ) - Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4) := by
      congr 1
      linear_combination (1 / 2 : ℂ) * log_pi_halves_sum
    _ = (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4) := by
      rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Complex.exp_add, ← Complex.ofReal_exp,
        Real.exp_log Real.pi_pos]

theorem quarter_phase_plus :
    Complex.exp (Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4) =
      Complex.I * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4) := by
  have hi : Complex.exp (Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 2) = Complex.I := by
    convert Complex.exp_pi_div_two_mul_I using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> ring
  calc
    _ = Complex.exp (Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 2 +
        -Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4) := by congr 1; ring
    _ = Complex.exp (Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 2) *
        Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4) := Complex.exp_add _ _
    _ = _ := by rw [hi]

theorem quarter_phase_minus :
    Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4) =
      -Complex.I * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4) := by
  have hi : Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 2) = -Complex.I := by
    convert Complex.exp_neg_pi_div_two_mul_I using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> ring
  calc
    _ = Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 2 +
        Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4) := by congr 1; ring
    _ = Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 2) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4) := Complex.exp_add _ _
    _ = _ := by rw [hi]

theorem component_phase_plus (z : ℂ) :
    Complex.exp (Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * z) =
      Complex.I * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (z - (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4)) := by
  rw [quarter_phase_plus]
  rw [mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
  congr 2
  ring

theorem component_phase_minus (z : ℂ) :
    -(Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4) * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * z)) =
      Complex.I * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (z - (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4)) := by
  rw [quarter_phase_minus]
  have harg : Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4 + -Complex.I * z =
      -Complex.I * (z - (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4) := by ring
  rw [mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add, harg]
  ring

have hscaled : ((Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (J0 z * D) =
      (P * D) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * z) * APlus z -
        (M * D) * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * z) * AMinus z := by
    linear_combination D * hconn
  rw [hP, hM] at hscaled
  have hphases :
      ((Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * z) * APlus z -
        ((Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4)) *
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * z) * AMinus z =
      ((Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (z - (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4)) * APlus z +
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (z - (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4)) * AMinus z) := by
    have hp := component_phase_plus z
    have hm := component_phase_minus z
    linear_combination (Real.pi : ℂ) * APlus z * hp +
      (Real.pi : ℂ) * AMinus z * hm
  rw [hphases] at hscaled
  have hpiI : (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero) Complex.I_ne_zero
  have hnum := (mul_right_inj' hpiI).mp hscaled
  have hD : D ≠ 0 := Complex.cpow_ne_zero_iff.mpr (Or.inl
    (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (2 : ℂ) ≠ 0)
      (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero)) (rightHalfPlane_ne_zero hz)))
  exact (eq_div_iff hD).2 hnum

entries.title: 闭主扇区参数与κ
entries.source_excerpt:
Let $z=x+iy=\rho e^{i\theta}$, where $\rho>0$ and
$0\le\theta\le\pi/4$, and put $\kappa=2^{-9/4}$.
entries.bridges: 闭扇区实际定义为0≤Im z≤Re z且Re z>0；revision_closed_sector_arg_iff把它与z≠0及0≤arg z≤π/4严格等价。κ实际定义正是Real.rpow 2 (-9/4)。ρ按范数解释。

local_evidence.actual_source_text: def ClosedPrincipalSector (z : ℂ) : Prop := 0 ≤ z.im ∧ z.im ≤ z.re ∧ 0 < z.re
def kappa : ℝ := Real.rpow 2 (-9 / 4 : ℝ)

theorem revision_closed_sector_arg_iff (z : ℂ) :
    ClosedPrincipalSector z ↔ z ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ z.arg ∧ z.arg ≤ Real.pi / 4 := by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by intro he; simp [he, ClosedPrincipalSector] at hz
    have hhalf := Complex.arg_lt_pi_div_two_iff.mpr (Or.inl hz.2.2)
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ z.arg := Complex.arg_nonneg_iff.mpr hz.1
    have hm : z.arg ∈ Ioo (-(Real.pi / 2)) (Real.pi / 2) := ⟨by linarith [Real.pi_pos],hhalf⟩
    have hq : Real.pi / 4 ∈ Ioo (-(Real.pi / 2)) (Real.pi / 2) := by
      constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have ht : Real.tan z.arg ≤ Real.tan (Real.pi / 4) := by
      rw [Complex.tan_arg,Real.tan_pi_div_four]
      exact (div_le_one hz.2.2).mpr hz.2.1
    exact ⟨hz0,hnonneg,(Real.strictMonoOn_tan.le_iff_le hm hq).mp ht⟩
  · rintro ⟨hz0,hlo,hhi⟩
    have hn := norm_pos_iff.mpr hz0
    have hm : z.arg ∈ Ioo (-(Real.pi / 2)) (Real.pi / 2) := by
      constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have hr : 0 < z.re := by
      rw [← Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg z]
      exact mul_pos hn (Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo hm)
    have hi : 0 ≤ z.im := Complex.arg_nonneg_iff.mp hlo
    have hq : Real.pi / 4 ∈ Ioo (-(Real.pi / 2)) (Real.pi / 2) := by
      constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have ht := Real.strictMonoOn_tan.monotoneOn hm hq hhi
    rw [Complex.tan_arg,Real.tan_pi_div_four] at ht
    exact ⟨hi,(div_le_one hr).mp ht,hr⟩

entries.title: 积分核线段的几何模下界
entries.source_excerpt:
Since $x\ge y\ge0$ and $x>0$, completing squares in Cartesian
coordinates gives, for $t\ge0$ and $0\le\sigma\le1$,
\[
   \left|1+\sigma\frac{it}{2z}\right|^2\ge1,
   \qquad
   \left|1-\sigma\frac{it}{2z}\right|^2\ge\frac12.
\]

theorem sector_plus_base_norm_sq {z : ℂ} (hz : ClosedPrincipalSector z)

  have he : 1 + Complex.I * (t : ℂ) / (2 * z) = (z + Complex.I * (t : ℂ) / 2) / z := by
    field_simp

    rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, ← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
      Complex.div_ofNat_re, Complex.div_ofNat_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]

    (Real.rpow 2 (3 / 4 : ℝ)) (fun s hs => by
      rw [he]
      exact (amplitude_bases_mem_slitPlane hz.2.2 (mul_nonneg hs.1 ht)).2)
    (fun s _ => by rw [he]; exact minus_three_halves_bound hz (s * t))
  rw [show 1 + -Complex.I * (t : ℂ) / (2 * z) =
      1 - Complex.I * (t : ℂ) / (2 * z) by ring] at h
  change ‖minusKernel z t - 1‖ ≤ _ at h
  calc
    _ ≤ (‖-Complex.I * (t : ℂ) / (2 * z)‖ / 2) * Real.rpow 2 (3 / 4 : ℝ) := h

theorem weightedIntegral_norm_le_half {g : ℝ → ℂ} {D : ℝ}
    (hb : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ‖g t‖ ≤ D * t) : ‖weightedIntegral g‖ ≤ D / 2 := by
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ)),
      ‖(muDensity t : ℂ) * g t‖ ≤ D * (t * muDensity t) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (muDensity_nonneg t ht.le)]
    calc
      _ ≤ muDensity t * (D * t) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb t ht) (muDensity_nonneg t ht.le)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hh := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (firstMoment_integrableOn.const_mul D) hbound
  change ‖weightedIntegral g‖ ≤ _ at hh
  rw [integral_const_mul, firstMoment_integral] at hh
  convert hh using 1 <;> ring

theorem amplitude_uniform_estimates : AmplitudeUniformEstimatesStatement := by
  intro z hz
  let C : ℝ := Real.rpow 2 (3 / 4 : ℝ)
  have hzn : 0 < ‖z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (rightHalfPlane_ne_zero hz.2.2)
  have hk : kappa = C / 8 := kappa_eq_power_three_quarters_div_eight
  have hint := amplitude_integrability z hz.2.2
  have hp : ‖APlus z - 1‖ ≤ kappa / ‖z‖ := by
    rw [APlus, weightedIntegral_sub_one_eq hint.1]
    have hh := weightedIntegral_norm_le_half (fun t ht => plusKernel_sub_one_bound hz ht.le)
    calc
      _ ≤ (C / (4 * ‖z‖)) / 2 := hh
      _ = _ := by rw [hk]; ring
  have hm : ‖AMinus z - 1‖ ≤ kappa / ‖z‖ := by
    rw [AMinus, weightedIntegral_sub_one_eq hint.2.1]
    have hh := weightedIntegral_norm_le_half (fun t ht => minusKernel_sub_one_bound hz ht.le)
    calc
      _ ≤ (C / (4 * ‖z‖)) / 2 := hh
      _ = _ := by rw [hk]; ring
  have hpm : ‖weightedIntegral (plusMomentKernel z)‖ ≤ C / 2 := by
    apply weightedIntegral_norm_le_half
    intro t ht
    unfold plusMomentKernel
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_of_nonneg ht.le]
    calc
      _ ≤ t * C := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (plus_three_halves_bound hz ht.le) ht.le
      _ = C * t := mul_comm _ _
  have hmm : ‖weightedIntegral (minusMomentKernel z)‖ ≤ C / 2 := by
    apply weightedIntegral_norm_le_half
    intro t ht
    unfold minusMomentKernel
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_of_nonneg ht.le]
    calc
      _ ≤ t * C := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (minus_three_halves_bound hz t) ht.le
      _ = C * t := mul_comm _ _
  have hp' : ‖deriv APlus z‖ ≤ kappa / ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [(APlus_hasDerivAt hz.2.2).deriv, norm_mul]
    have hn : ‖Complex.I / (4 * z ^ 2)‖ = 1 / (4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2) := by simp
    rw [hn]
    calc
      _ ≤ (1 / (4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2)) * (C / 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpm (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by rw [hk]; ring
  have hm' : ‖deriv AMinus z‖ ≤ kappa / ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [(AMinus_hasDerivAt hz.2.2).deriv, norm_mul]
    have hn : ‖-Complex.I / (4 * z ^ 2)‖ = 1 / (4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2) := by simp
    rw [hn]
    calc
      _ ≤ (1 / (4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2)) * (C / 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmm (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by rw [hk]; ring
  exact ⟨hp, hm, hp', hm'⟩

theorem paper_factorization : FactorizationStatement :=
  factorization_of_exactDecomposition exact_decomposition

theorem factorization_of_exactDecomposition
    (h : ExactDecompositionStatement) : FactorizationStatement := by
  intro z hz
  have hm : AMinus z ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hz.2).2
  let χ : ℂ := z - (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4
  let D : ℂ := Complex.cpow (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * z) (1 / 2 : ℂ)
  have he : Complex.exp (-Complex.I * χ) * Complex.exp (2 * Complex.I * χ) =
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * χ) := by
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hc : (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * χ) * AMinus z / D) *
      (Complex.exp (2 * Complex.I * χ) * APlus z / AMinus z) =
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * χ) * APlus z / D := by
    calc
      _ = ((Complex.exp (-Complex.I * χ) * Complex.exp (2 * Complex.I * χ)) *
          APlus z / D) * (AMinus z / AMinus z) := by ring
      _ = Complex.exp (Complex.I * χ) * APlus z / D := by
        rw [div_self hm, mul_one, he]
  change J0 z = (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * χ) * AMinus z / D) *
    (1 + Complex.exp (2 * Complex.I * χ) * APlus z / AMinus z)
  calc
    J0 z = (Complex.exp (Complex.I * χ) * APlus z +
        Complex.exp (-Complex.I * χ) * AMinus z) / D := h z hz.1
    _ = Complex.exp (-Complex.I * χ) * AMinus z / D +
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * χ) * APlus z / D := by ring
    _ = Complex.exp (-Complex.I * χ) * AMinus z / D +
        (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * χ) * AMinus z / D) *
          (Complex.exp (2 * Complex.I * χ) * APlus z / AMinus z) := by rw [hc]
    _ = _ := by ring

theorem revision_one_point_cosh_bounds {z : ℂ} (hJ : J0 z = 1)
    (hz : PrincipalSector z) :

  have hhigh : Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * ‖z‖) ≤ (17 / 8 : ℝ) * Real.cosh z.im := by

    linarith
  have hcosh : (8 / 17 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (8 * Real.pi) ≤ Real.cosh z.im := by
    linarith

    lt_of_lt_of_le weighted_sqrt_eight_pi_gt_eleven_fifths hcosh⟩

theorem one_point_sqrt_bound_of_exact (hexact : ExactDecompositionStatement)
    {z : ℂ} (hJ : J0 z = 1) (hz : PrincipalSector z) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * ‖z‖) ≤
      (17 / 16 : ℝ) * (Real.exp z.im + Real.exp (-z.im)) := by

  obtain ⟨_, hp, _, hm, _, _⟩ := amplitude_modulus_bounds z (principalSector_closed hz) hr
  have he := congrArg (fun u : ℂ => u *
      Complex.cpow (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * z) (1 / 2 : ℂ))
    (hexact z (lt_trans hz.1 hz.2))
  have hden : Complex.cpow (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * z) (1 / 2 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    apply Complex.cpow_ne_zero_iff.mpr
    left
    exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num)
      (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero)) (principalSector_ne_zero hz)
  rw [hJ, one_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hden] at he
  have h := norm_add_le
    (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (z - (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4)) * APlus z)

      Real.exp (-z.im) := by rw [Complex.norm_exp]; congr 1; simp
  have he2 : ‖Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (z - (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4))‖ =
      Real.exp z.im := by rw [Complex.norm_exp]; congr 1; simp

    _ ≤ Real.exp (-z.im) * ‖APlus z‖ + Real.exp z.im * ‖AMinus z‖ := h

theorem outward_exponential_factor_le_one
    {τ y : ℝ} (hτ : 1 ≤ τ) (hy : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ y) :
    τ * Real.exp (-2 * (τ - 1) * y) ≤ 1 := by
  have hτpos : 0 < τ := by linarith
  have hlog : Real.log τ ≤ τ - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hτpos
  have hprod : 0 ≤ (τ - 1) * (2 * y - 1) :=
    mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hτ) (by linarith)
  calc
    τ * Real.exp (-2 * (τ - 1) * y) =
        Real.exp (Real.log τ + (-2 * (τ - 1) * y)) := by
      rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hτpos]
    _ ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith)

/-- The exact initial-separation hypothesis in the paper implies the outward factor bound. -/
theorem outward_exponential_factor_le_one_of_separation
    {τ y : ℝ} (hτ : 1 ≤ τ) (hy : (7 / 5 : ℝ) < y) :
    τ * Real.exp (-2 * (τ - 1) * y) ≤ 1 :=
  outward_exponential_factor_le_one hτ (by linarith)

theorem outward_rho_exp_bound
    {τ ρ y B : ℝ} (hτ : 1 ≤ τ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hy : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ y) (hbound : ρ * Real.exp (-2 * y) < B) :
    (τ * ρ) * Real.exp (-2 * (τ * y)) < B := by
  have hfactor := outward_exponential_factor_le_one hτ hy
  have hbase : 0 ≤ ρ * Real.exp (-2 * y) :=
    mul_nonneg hρ (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hscale : (τ * ρ) * Real.exp (-2 * (τ * y)) =
      (ρ * Real.exp (-2 * y)) * (τ * Real.exp (-2 * (τ - 1) * y)) := by
    have he : -2 * (τ * y) = -2 * y + -2 * (τ - 1) * y := by ring
    rw [he, Real.exp_add]
    ring
  rw [hscale]
  calc
    (ρ * Real.exp (-2 * y)) * (τ * Real.exp (-2 * (τ - 1) * y)) ≤
        (ρ * Real.exp (-2 * y)) * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfactor hbase
    _ = ρ * Real.exp (-2 * y) := mul_one _
    _ < B := hbound

theorem radialDerivativeDecomposition_of_factorization_and_ray

    simpa only [Function.comp_def, id_eq, one_mul] using
      (hcomplex.comp (τ : ℂ) ((hasDerivAt_id (τ : ℂ)).mul_const z)).comp_ofReal

theorem delta_derivative_of_hasDerivAt {z : ℂ}
    (hp : HasDerivAt APlus (deriv APlus z) z)
    (hm : HasDerivAt AMinus (deriv AMinus z) z)
    (hp0 : APlus z ≠ 0) (hm0 : AMinus z ≠ 0) :
    z * deriv delta z = delta z *
      (2 * Complex.I * z + z * deriv APlus z / APlus z -
        z * deriv AMinus z / AMinus z) := by
  let E : ℂ := Complex.exp (2 * Complex.I * (z - (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4))
  have he : HasDerivAt
      (fun w : ℂ => Complex.exp (2 * Complex.I * (w - (Real.pi : ℂ) / 4)))
      (E * (2 * Complex.I)) z := by
    simpa [E] using
      (((hasDerivAt_id z).sub_const ((Real.pi : ℂ) / 4)).const_mul
        (2 * Complex.I)).cexp
  have hd : HasDerivAt delta
      (((E * (2 * Complex.I) * APlus z + E * deriv APlus z) * AMinus z -
        (E * APlus z) * deriv AMinus z) / AMinus z ^ 2) z :=
    (he.mul hp).div hm hm0
  rw [hd.deriv]
  change z *
      (((E * (2 * Complex.I) * APlus z + E * deriv APlus z) * AMinus z -
        (E * APlus z) * deriv AMinus z) / AMinus z ^ 2) =
    (E * APlus z / AMinus z) *
      (2 * Complex.I * z + z * deriv APlus z / APlus z -
        z * deriv AMinus z / AMinus z)
  field_simp [hp0, hm0] <;> ring

entries.title: 对数导数扰动项小于31/50
entries.bridges: 不能仅拿complex_radial_error_bound最终<31/50冒充中间式。其真实局部hden/hT/hn/hdiv给扰动≤|b|+变量分式；radial_error_bound局部hprod/hnum/hden/hdiv给该分式≤固定分式。再保留实际严格输入|b|<1/15，得到扰动<1/15+固定分式；radial_error_constant直接给该固定常数<31/50。revision_radial_log_derivative的he实际以A±对数导数、delta、delta′及真实ray_separation与delta_derivative实例化全部generic输入。严格固定上界虽未作为独立顶层声明，来自这些实际proof-local项及严格加法桥，不是由最终<31/50逆推。

theorem complex_radial_error_bound (z a b d d' : ℂ)
    (ha : ‖a‖ < (1 / 15 : ℝ)) (hb : ‖b‖ < (1 / 15 : ℝ))
    (hd : ‖d‖ < (17 / 240 : ℝ)) (hzd : ‖z‖ * ‖d‖ < (187 / 750 : ℝ))
    (heq : z * d' = d * (2 * Complex.I * z + a - b)) :
    ‖b + z * d' / (1 + d)‖ < (31 / 50 : ℝ) := by
  have hden : 1 - ‖d‖ ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ) + d‖ := by
    have hh := norm_sub_le ((1 : ℂ) + d) d
    rw [add_sub_cancel_right, norm_one] at hh
    linarith
  have hdenpos : 0 < 1 - ‖d‖ := by linarith
  have hT : ‖2 * Complex.I * z + a - b‖ ≤ 2 * ‖z‖ + ‖a‖ + ‖b‖ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖2 * Complex.I * z + a‖ + ‖b‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ (‖2 * Complex.I * z‖ + ‖a‖) + ‖b‖ :=
        add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) le_rfl
      _ = _ := by simp [norm_mul]
  have hn : ‖d‖ * ‖2 * Complex.I * z + a - b‖ ≤
      2 * (‖z‖ * ‖d‖) + (‖b‖ + ‖a‖) * ‖d‖ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖d‖ * (2 * ‖z‖ + ‖a‖ + ‖b‖) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hdiv : ‖z * d' / (1 + d)‖ ≤
      (2 * (‖z‖ * ‖d‖) + (‖b‖ + ‖a‖) * ‖d‖) / (1 - ‖d‖) := by
    rw [heq, norm_div, norm_mul]
    exact div_le_div₀ (by positivity) hn hdenpos hden
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖b‖ + ‖z * d' / (1 + d)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ ‖b‖ + (2 * (‖z‖ * ‖d‖) + (‖b‖ + ‖a‖) * ‖d‖) / (1 - ‖d‖) :=
      add_le_add le_rfl hdiv
    _ < _ := radial_error_bound hb.le ha.le (norm_nonneg _) hd.le hzd.le

theorem radial_error_bound {a b d q : ℝ}
    (ha : a ≤ 1 / 15) (hb : b ≤ 1 / 15)
    (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hd : d ≤ 17 / 240)
    (hq : q ≤ 187 / 750) :
    a + (2 * q + (a + b) * d) / (1 - d) < 31 / 50 := by
  have hab : a + b ≤ 2 / 15 := by linarith
  have hprod : (a + b) * d ≤ (2 / 15 : ℝ) * (17 / 240) := by
    calc
      (a + b) * d ≤ (2 / 15 : ℝ) * d :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hab hd0
      _ ≤ (2 / 15 : ℝ) * (17 / 240) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (by norm_num)
  have hnum : 2 * q + (a + b) * d ≤
      2 * (187 / 750) + (2 / 15 : ℝ) * (17 / 240) := by
    linarith
  have hden : (1 - 17 / 240 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - d := by linarith
  have hdiv := div_le_div₀ (by norm_num :
      (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (187 / 750) + (2 / 15) * (17 / 240))
      hnum (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 - 17 / 240) hden
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (add_le_add ha hdiv) radial_error_constant

The bound \eqref{eq:radial-log-derivative} gives $H'(\tau)>0$ for

$c>1$, which proves \eqref{eq:principal-radial-escape}.

theorem revision_ray_corrected_log_one {z : ℂ} (hJ : J0 z = 1) :

theorem logarithmic_growth_of_radial_derivative
    (l d : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℝ) (hstart : l 1 = 0)
    (hderiv : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → HasDerivAt l (d t) t)
    (hbound : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → k < t * d t)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 < c) : k * Real.log c < l c := by
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => l t - k * Real.log t
  have hgderiv (t : ℝ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
      HasDerivAt g (d t - k * t⁻¹) t := by
    have htpos : 0 < t := by linarith
    exact (hderiv t ht).sub ((Real.hasDerivAt_log htpos.ne').const_mul k)
  have hgpos (t : ℝ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) : 0 < d t - k * t⁻¹ := by
    have htpos : 0 < t := by linarith
    have hdiv : k / t < d t := (div_lt_iff₀ htpos).mpr (by
      simpa only [mul_comm] using hbound t ht)
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using sub_pos.mpr hdiv
  have hmono : StrictMonoOn g (Set.Ici 1) := by
    apply strictMonoOn_of_deriv_pos (convex_Ici 1)
    · intro t ht
      exact (hgderiv t ht).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · intro t ht
      have ht' : 1 ≤ t := interior_subset ht
      rw [(hgderiv t ht').deriv]
      exact hgpos t ht'
  have hgc : g 1 < g c := hmono (by simp) hc.le hc
  dsimp [g] at hgc
  rw [hstart, Real.log_one] at hgc
  linarith

/-- The exponent used in Proposition 5.1. This remains a generic calculus statement. -/
theorem logarithmic_growth_seven_twentyfifths
    (l d : ℝ → ℝ) (hstart : l 1 = 0)
    (hderiv : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → HasDerivAt l (d t) t)
    (hbound : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → (7 / 25 : ℝ) < t * d t)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 < c) : (7 / 25 : ℝ) * Real.log c < l c :=
  logarithmic_growth_of_radial_derivative l d (7 / 25) hstart hderiv hbound hc

theorem quadrantRep_orbit (z : ℂ) :

entries.source_excerpt:
\begin{corollary}
\label{cor:global-two-radius}
Let $f\in L^1_{\mathrm{loc}}(\R^2)$, and let $r_1\ne r_2$ be positive.  If
\[
   M_{r_1}f=M_{r_2}f=f\quad\text{a.e. on }\R^2,
\]
then $\Delta f=0$ in $\D'(\R^2)$.  Consequently, $f$ agrees almost
everywhere with a smooth harmonic function.  If $f$ is continuous, then
$f$ itself is harmonic and has the circular mean-value property at every
positive radius.
\end{corollary}
